lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. Three words are asked of Brandon and all three still stand. One: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first, asked in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday. Two: take the level line's mend, yes or no, asked in Status 262. Three: take the two what-ifs that both fresh reviewers say to take, fall's lit faces going out before winter's base comes and summer's sand mound breaking up as it leaves, yes or no. The work goes on in any case and only the freeze waits.

Since Status 276 at 9:57 AM MT: decision 323 is in the log. The fireflies' what-if is pushed on its own branch, one commit of three files, and nothing of it is on the main branch. What it does: in a film frame the globe travels while the shutter is open, and each firefly was drawn at every moment of that travel, so one short streak was swept sideways into a flat square. The main branch already holds each light against the globe's travel from the end of the take over into summer until nine seconds after summer lands. The what-if makes that same hold stand in every film frame in which summer's lights show while the globe travels, film frames 1368 to 2123 as its builder states, and brings it on by degrees at the lift so that no light jumps. The live page, the stills and the loop are not touched by it, as its builder states from its tests. Its builder drew film frame 2072 at 4K and says every light is one thin stroke. That is its word and not yet seen here.

Its proofs are ordered. The same three helper machines that drew the before frames now draw the after of all fourteen frames with the same tool and count of samples, due between 10:42 and 10:55 AM MT. And four more machines draw a motion proof at 4K as the masters draw it, both sides on each machine: nine frames in a row in the fast part of the shake out of summer, film frames 2067 to 2075, and fifteen in a row at the lift, film frames 2016 to 2030. They are due 11:25 to 11:30 AM MT. Why now: the squares stand only in the masters' drawing, so the what-if's motion can be judged only there, and a yes should not be held up by it later. Two fresh reviewers judge it after that, and it is put to Brandon only if both say take it.

The before set is whole, fourteen frames at 4K as the masters draw them. First picture: film frame 1376 whole, the shake out of spring, the glass full of pink storm. Second picture: film frame 1403 whole, the white of the take over into summer. Third picture: film frame 2024 cut at own size, summer as the lift begins. The globe travels under 7 pixels in that frame and the lights are mostly round and soft, with some thin strokes round the crown.

Not right, the leaves' edge. Its builder's first try at the last ruled line failed its own look and is not committed: the line at film frame 2163 moved by about 1 pixel, measured by it, and it withdrew the cause it had named. A second try runs. Ruled: this one try more, and if the line still stands the leaves' what-if stays as it was, with that fault named, and is not offered. Its mail is now due by 11:00 AM MT and the mound's second answer about 11:25 AM MT.

The render handoff: the first hosted proof has ended, READ at 10:09 AM MT. Its verdict table as its builder read it stands as in Status 276 and is not yet read here. The third cold reader's list is due 10:50 AM MT, the second whole hosted run follows it, and the builder's report comes about 12:15 PM MT. No cloud final render is started. The lost drawing's mend: its builder has read the first of four hosted machines, measured by it: 24 browsers, 5 losses, and after a loss the visitor's reload was refused six times for up to 108 seconds and drew again at 128 seconds. Its account of what holds the drawing back moves from 10:30 to 10:45 AM MT because two machines began late.

Open and awaited, by my orders' limits in Mountain Time. The hosted Mac report at 10:24 AM. The after frames 10:42 to 10:55 AM. The lost drawing's account 10:45 AM and its ten must items 11:45 AM, then a second fresh reviewer of another model family before anything merges. The third cold reader 10:50 AM. The leaves' edge 11:00 AM. The mound's second answer and the motion proof about 11:25 AM. The fireflies' report 11:50 AM, the render handoff's report about 12:15 PM and the veil's what-if by 1:45 PM.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code, after the steps above. The what-ifs, each shown before and after at 4K with the reviewers' words. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 10:11 AM MT Saturday, 52 rows, the last call 10:47 PM MT Wednesday).
